services.name: Scenic 30A Bike Trail
services.desc: The Scenic 30A Bike Trail follows the coastline and links the beach towns of Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach and Seaside. Riders enjoy a smooth paved path with ocean views, dunes, and shaded areas. People hire bikes at Rosemary Beach and enjoy the ride at their own speed. The trail is open every day from sunrise to sunset.
